exposure: Early-pregnancy oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) glucose (fasting, 1-h, and 2-h values)
outcome: Perinatal composite (birth <37 + 0 weeks, birth trauma, birth weight ≥4,500 g, respiratory distress, phototherapy requirement, stillbirth/neonatal death, shoulder dystocia)
cohort: Participants were 3,645 individuals with risk factors for hyperglycemia, recruited for an international, multicenter, randomized controlled gestational diabetes mellitus treatment trial (TOBOGM cohort).
finding: Continuous positive associations were observed between early-pregnancy OGTT glucose (fasting, 1-h, and 2-h values) and various pregnancy complications, including late GDM, perinatal composite outcomes, large-for-gestational-age offspring, cesarean section, and neonatal hypoglycemia, with only the high-band 1-h glucose predicting major perinatal complications in categorical analysis.
mod_finding: Significant associations were observed between 1-h glucose and cesarean section.
